files.description: Canonical domain vocabulary for presets, layout modes, layout mappings, tab actions, and command shortcuts
Supported browsers, permissions, user-visible behavior, local checks, and release commands
Repository rule to use CONTEXT.md and relevant ADRs as the domain source of truth
Command shortcuts are browser-managed; the extension owns command behavior, not arbitrary key capture
Layout detection uses window and active-tab geometry with explicit manual overrides
Privacy boundary: no accounts, servers, analytics, telemetry, browsing content, or unnecessary permissions
Shared WebExtension core with thin browser-specific manifests and adapters
Executable manifest, permission, command, and remote-code release invariants
